design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (debt_waivers_disputes_and_repayment), frozen_time 2026-10-05.

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 6, 5, 4]}. Assignment: reinstatement deposit 5, waiver amount 4, plan term 4, plan installment (root) 6. Task 1 draw (headroom check): 2 prerequisite problems, counts [6, 4, 4].

[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing. Claimed here: debt_ext_plan_reinstatement_deposit (pay_plan_reinstatement_66656e17, owner user, debt_payment_received), debt_ext_waiver_request_amount (submit_waiver_request_4f8614a0, owner user, debt_waiver_requested), debt_ext_plan_request_term (record_repayment_plan_request_018c5870, agent, debt_repayment_plan_requested kind repayment_plan), debt_ext_plan_installment (start_repayment_plan_5152504c, agent, debt_plan_started direct_payment). Left for task 1: the reduced-withholding request and its start (debt_repayment_plan_requested kind reduced_withholding; debt_plan_started benefit_withholding) and the compromise offer (debt_compromise_offered, owner user) - three independent writes on a different debt type (Veterans Pension Overpayment), so task 1 keeps a full tree of its own.

[Why a good test] The caller asks only to get back on monthly payments after his plan was cancelled. The root write (the new installment) is hidden behind three hops the agent must read out of the rules: the installment waits on a plan request dated today; the plan request's months wait on a waiver request carrying the debtor's signed Financial Status Report (a plan longer than 12 months needs a report, and a report reaches a debt only with a request the debtor signs); the waiver amount waits on the reinstatement deposit owed for the cancelled plan. Every hop carries a value: deposit -> balance and payment count; waiver request -> report count, pending cut, and the amount the installment deducts; plan request -> months. Breadth: each computation reads the debt ledger (payments, requests, decisions), date spans (notice age, months since approval) and the compensation award in another difficulty (rating, running status, monthly rate, six months of compensation payments).

[Problem-tree card] root debt_ext_plan_installment.
 edge 1: installment -> plan term, value_input, gate months_requested, form state, sentence (negated direction) 'A repayment plan's monthly installment is not fixed until the debt carries a repayment plan request received on the day the plan starts, stating the number of months the plan is to run.' Only record_repayment_plan_request_018c5870 writes a repayment plan request. False at opening: debt_requests c333a2a2... is the only plan request, received 2026-06-24, 12 months. Skip effect: 72.18 -> 301.83.
 edge 2: plan term -> waiver amount, value_input, gate waiver_fsr_requests, form state, sentence (affirmative) 'For a debtor who asks for a plan longer than the longest plan approved without a Financial Status Report, the number of months on the repayment plan request is fixed only after the debt carries a waiver request, received in the last six months, with the debtor's signed Financial Status Report attached.' Only submit_waiver_request_4f8614a0 writes a waiver request. False at opening: no debt_waiver_requested row. Skip effect: 47 -> 3.
 edge 3: waiver amount -> reinstatement deposit, value_input, gate balance, form state, sentence (affirmative) 'The amount a waiver request asks VA to waive is fixed only after the debt's ledger carries the reinstatement deposit owed on any repayment plan of the debt that was cancelled for missed installments.' Only pay_plan_reinstatement_66656e17 posts a reinstatement deposit. False at opening: status active with plan fields reset, a granted plan decision, and only the 2026-07-22 installment on the ledger. Skip effect: 1753.82 -> 1503.82.
 Four-point test on each sentence: ordering connective ('only after' / 'not until'); waits on a record-visible state; no tool, id or snake_case token; strength matches the condition. Topological order: deposit, waiver request, plan request, plan start (a chain, nothing to reorder). Two problems are the customer's own writes (deposit payment, signed waiver request).

[Base-invariant card] Step 9 (debt_payment_received): debt_agg_collection_order and debt_evt_repayment_plan, no gate for this subject (policy_scope). Step 11 (debt_waiver_requested): debt_evt_waiver.waiver_window - notice 2026-06-10 (debt_accounts.notice_date), 180 days counted from the day after the notice, inclusive, last timely day 2026-12-07, today day 117 -> satisfied; just-fails case 2026-12-08. debt_excl_single_pending_request.no_undecided_request - the debt's requests are a plan request and its decision; no waiver, dispute or compromise is undecided -> satisfied. Step 13 (debt_repayment_plan_requested): debt_evt_repayment_plan.plan_on_active_debt - status active -> satisfied. Step 15 (debt_plan_started): debt_evt_repayment_plan policy_scope. Base clause superseded by the installment policy is declared in its overwrite (the 'at least the balance divided by the months' clause), because the installment now spreads the balance net of a pending waiver request and applies rates.

[Business-object card] Target object: the Disability Compensation Overpayment 7617225e... created from the spouse removal 54d85c1b... (divorce 2023-05-12, effective 2023-06-01, payment adjusted 2026-06): 36 months x 154.21 = 5551.56. Rows in the aggregates: the one direct payment 500.00 of 2026-07-22 (plan month 2026-07), the plan request and its granted decision of 2026-06-24. Excluded: nothing else exists on the debt; there are no offsets because the debt was in a direct-payment plan from July until it defaulted after the 2026-10-01 compensation payment.

[Factor card] (figures from the sensitivity run below)
 deposit: installments_counted method -> 1 (baseline 2, result 425.70); installment_value method -> 420.97 (baseline 462.63, 217.08); deposit_floor parameter comp -> 450.00 (baseline 25.00, 194.16); deposit_pct parameter comp multi-source -> 55 (baseline 100, 412.63); excess_credit parameter -> 37.37 (baseline 0, 247.50). Fall-back 925.26. Near-miss: the 500.00 payment looks like an ordinary installment but 37.37 of it is excess.
 waiver amount: monthly_capacity parameter comp multi-source -> 180.845 (baseline 25.00, 5026.56); horizon_months parameter -> 24 (baseline 12, 3923.96); horizon_counted method -> 21 (baseline 24, 1211.28); repaid_credit parameter -> 710.13 (baseline 0, 1043.69). Fall-back 4541.43. Near-miss: the July payment and today's deposit are both counted; the compensation payments are not debt payments.
 plan term: longest_term parameter -> 60 (baseline 12, 1); months_run method -> 3 (baseline 0, 50); rating_cut parameter comp -> 6 (baseline 0, 53); pending_cut parameter -> 4 (baseline 0, 51). Fall-back 12.
 installment: spread_balance method -> 3087.61 (baseline 4841.43, 113.18); spread_months parameter comp -> 46 (baseline 47, 70.65); uplift_pct parameter comp -> 110 (baseline 100, 65.62); relief_pct parameter comp history multi-source -> 95 (baseline 100, 75.98); restart_pct parameter multi-source -> 105 (baseline 100, 68.74); notice_pct parameter multi-source -> 98 (baseline 100, 73.65). Fall-back 103.01. Near-miss: the April 2026 compensation payment (1962.66) falls outside the six-month window and is not counted; the March and April payments look like part of the drop history.

[Seed rows] customers (identity), comp award 70 percent running (cross-difficulty tiers), 8 monthly compensation payments March-October 2026 (1962.66 before the June adjustment, 1808.45 after; relief tier and confirmation that no offset was taken), spouse added/removed rows (originating record of the debt), the debt, its one payment, the plan request and decision. Removing the payment changes the count, excess and credits; removing the decision removes the cancelled-plan tiers; removing the comp award moves every comp factor to its fall-through.

[Persona] Desmond K. Harrow, tired shift worker on his break, plain speech. Volunteers only the goal (back on monthly payments, lowest and longest allowed, set up today). Gives phone 7045550186 to be found and SSN last four 5318, VA file 352741869, DOB 1979-04-18 one at a time when asked. Passive: pays what he is told to pay when the payment is handed to him; signs a request with his Financial Status Report attached when handed one; repeats the monthly amount and ends when told the plan is set. He never mentions deposits, waivers or plan requests on his own and never corrects a figure.

[Standard solution] Locate by phone, verify with three credentials, read debt, transactions, requests, compensation award, compensation payments and dependency actions. Then: (9) hand over the deposit payment, amount 210.13; (11) hand over the waiver request, 1753.82, report attached, outside the hold window; (13) record the plan request, 47 months; (15) start the plan, 72.18 from 2026-11.

[Verification run] Handling-time recomputation with check_compute's evaluator, replaying gold writes in order: deposit 210.13 (fall-back 925.26), waiver 1753.82 (4541.43), term 47 (12), installment 72.18 (103.01). Prerequisite skips: skip step 9 -> waiver 1503.82; skip step 11 -> term 3; skip step 13 -> installment 301.83. Gates run per task: check_extended, check_task_tools, replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_compute, check_grounding, check_cache_diff, check_cross_fire.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] From the published rules alone: the installment rule names the plan request it waits on; the term rule names the waiver request with a report; the waiver rule names the deposit for a cancelled plan; the records show the cancelled plan (granted decision, status active, plan fields reset) and no deposit, no waiver request, no request dated today. Reading each rule's ladders against the records reproduces 210.13, 1753.82, 47 and 72.18; no second reading of a tier was found.

[Rework round 2, audit policy_task/debt_waivers_disputes_and_repayment]
G1 symptom: the plan-term prerequisite sentence made a waiver request with a Financial Status Report a precondition of every plan request, contradicting base 'a plan of up to plan_max_months_without_fsr months is approved on request' and the policy's own 12-month fall-through. Change: the sentence is now conditional ('For a debtor who asks for a plan longer than the longest plan approved without a Financial Status Report, ...'), the rule restates that a plan within the no-report limit is approved on request, and the base clause 'a plan of up to plan_max_months_with_fsr months only with a Financial Status Report' is declared in overwrite with this sentence as its replacement (the extended policy names which signed request carries the report). The caller asks for the lowest payment 'stretched out as long as allowed', so the conditional edge still binds here; values unchanged (47 months, 72.18).
G4 symptom: longest_term's waiver conjunct held for everyone who reached the write, leaving the fall-through unreachable. With the conditional gate, a debtor asking for a plan within the no-report limit reaches the write with no waiver request and takes the 12-month fall-through, so all three tiers are reachable; plan_request_term keeps four factors.
G5 symptom: spread_months was labelled method although its tiers only substitute k into months - k. Change: relabelled effect parameter (values K('restart_months_off_comp') / K('restart_months_off_other') / none); plan_installment keeps spread_balance as its method factor. Figures unchanged (70.65).
O2: the deposit tool's docstring no longer says it reinstates the plan (it posts a deposit and sets up no plan); the plan-request docstring no longer mentions plan start. T0-O1: single-row conditions no longer labelled multi-source in factor_trace.
Gates re-run after the rework: see the final gate block.


[Rework round 3, audit revision_2]
R2-F1 symptom: spread_balance was labelled method although its tiers were one formula (balance - s x amount asked, s in 1 / 0.5 / 0), the shape the charter labels parameter elsewhere. Change: the tiers now apply different operations. With a complete waiver request (report attached) the amount asked is subtracted from the balance. With only an incomplete request (no report) the amount asked is not relied on and the balance is scaled down by its own plain-request reduction (20 percent, param plain_request_reduction_pct, replacing plain_waiver_share_pct), rounded to the cent. Otherwise the balance is spread as it stands. This is the same distinct-operation shape as the accepted approved_figure method (share-and-round / subtract a constant / as made). This world sits on the first tier (waiver request with report today), so spread_balance = 4841.43 - 1753.82 = 3087.61, its baseline gives 113.18, and gold stays 72.18. plan_installment now has one honest method factor (spread_balance) and five parameter factors.
user_scenario:
You are Desmond K. Harrow, a 47-year-old Army veteran living in Charlotte, North Carolina. You talk plainly and a little tiredly; you work shifts at a distribution warehouse and you are calling on your break, so you want this handled on this call without being bounced around. Some background you carry in your head: after your divorce in 2023 you did not tell VA right away, VA kept paying you the extra amount for your ex-wife for years, and in June VA sent you a letter saying you owed the overpayment back. You set up monthly payments on it in June, paid the first one in July, and then your hours were cut and you missed the August and September payments. This week you read that the payment plan was cancelled because of the missed payments and that VA will go back to keeping your compensation to cover the debt. Your disability compensation is your rent money, so what you want is simple: get back on monthly payments on that debt, with the lowest monthly payment VA allows and stretched out as long as allowed, and you want the representative to set it up for you today.

You open by saying you are calling about the VA debt from your old dependent overpayment because your payment plan got cancelled and you need to get back on monthly payments. When the representative asks how to find you, you give your phone number, 7045550186. When they ask you to confirm who you are, you give the last four of your Social Security number, 5318, your VA file number, 352741869, and your date of birth, 1979-04-18; you give these one at a time as asked rather than reciting everything at once. You do not know any internal reference numbers and you never quote a balance; if asked what you owe you say you think it is around five thousand dollars but you would rather they look it up.

You do not know VA's rules and you do not suggest steps. If the representative explains that something has to be paid or signed before the new plan can be set, you go along with it: when they tell you an amount you have to pay today and hand the payment over to you, you authorize that payment on the call from your checking account exactly as they set it up, and when they hand you a request to sign that goes in together with your Financial Status Report, you sign and submit it with your Financial Status Report attached, exactly as they set it up, because you have your monthly income and expense figures in front of you and can complete that report on the spot. You do not argue with any figure they give you; you only ask them to repeat it so you can write it down. If they ask how much you could afford each month, you say honestly that you cannot afford much, which is why you want the lowest amount VA allows. If they ask whether there is anything else going on with your benefits, you say no, just this.

Once the representative tells you the new monthly payment plan is set up and gives you the monthly amount, you repeat the amount back, thank them, and end the call. If at any point the representative says they cannot set up the plan, you ask once what you would need to do, listen, and then end the call politely.

edges.condition: The latest repayment plan request on the debt is dated the day the plan starts and states the number of months the plan is to run.
edges.policy_source: A repayment plan's monthly installment is not fixed until the debt carries a repayment plan request received on the day the plan starts, stating the number of months the plan is to run.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The only repayment plan request on the debt is the cancelled plan's request of 2026-06-24 for 12 months; none is dated 2026-10-05.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 13 records a plan request dated 2026-10-05 for 47 months, which becomes the latest request the installment reads.

edges.condition: Where the debtor asks for a plan longer than the no-report limit, the debt's requests include a waiver request received within the last six calendar months with a Financial Status Report attached; a debtor asking for a plan within the no-report limit needs none.
edges.policy_source: For a debtor who asks for a plan longer than the longest plan approved without a Financial Status Report, the number of months on the repayment plan request is fixed only after the debt carries a waiver request, received in the last six months, with the debtor's signed Financial Status Report attached.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The debt's only requests are a repayment plan request without a Financial Status Report and its decision; no waiver request exists.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 11 records a waiver request dated 2026-10-05 with fsr_submitted true; the longest term rises from 12 to 60 and the pending cut of 4 applies.

edges.condition: For a debt whose repayment plan was cancelled for missed installments, a direct payment equal to the reinstatement deposit stands among the debt's transactions, and the outstanding balance and the direct payments of the last six months reflect it.
edges.policy_source: The amount a waiver request asks VA to waive is fixed only after the debt's ledger carries the reinstatement deposit owed on any repayment plan of the debt that was cancelled for missed installments.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The plan was cancelled for missed installments and the only direct payment on the debt is the July installment; no reinstatement deposit stands on the ledger.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 9 posts the 210.13 deposit; the balance becomes 4841.43 and two direct payments stand in the last six months.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (installment <- plan term <- waiver amount <- reinstatement deposit); no problem has two prerequisites, so there is no parallel pair to reorder, and each write must follow the one it waits on: the deposit changes the balance and the payment count the waiver amount reads, the waiver request changes the report count and pending cut the term reads, and the plan request changes the months the installment reads.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the plan request (step 13): the installment reads the cancelled plan's 12 months, spread months 11, and monthly_amount becomes 301.83 instead of 72.18; the plan request row is also missing from the terminal state.
Skipping the waiver request (step 11): longest term 12 and no pending cut, so requested_term_months becomes 3 instead of 47 (and the installment changes with it).
Skipping the deposit (step 9): balance 5051.56 and one direct payment in six months (half credit 250.00), so requested_amount becomes 1503.82 instead of 1753.82.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only getting back on monthly payments. It never names the deposit, the waiver or the plan request or any policy id; it says nothing about forgiveness, deposits or reports on its own initiative. The only lines touching them are passive: if the representative explains something must be paid or signed first, he goes along with what is handed to him.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: task_tools.py: start_repayment_plan_5152504c only updates status, method, amount and start month; record_repayment_plan_request_018c5870 only creates the request row; submit_waiver_request_4f8614a0 only creates the request row; pay_plan_reinstatement_66656e17 only creates the payment row and lowers the balance. None reads another request, payment or status, none returns an error, so each writes faithfully even when its prerequisite is unresolved.
